corrections.reason: Non-Ethiopic character artifact (अ) in Draft Pass 1 replaced with the clearly printed Ethiopic Fidel አ in 'ኢአፃዕድዎ' (Matthew 5:36).
The printed text in Column 3, Line 9 clearly reads 'ጥቁርጥቁሩን' ('making the white black [and] the black white'), whereas Draft Pass 1 transposed ቁ and ሩ as 'ጥሩቁን'.
Both the printed glyph at the end of Line 28 and Ge'ez grammar require 6th-order 'ም' in 'ኢትምሐሉ' ('do not swear'), not 1st-order 'መ'.
